classes.purpose: Carry out scatter-bubble-analysis using the selected evidence and user instructions
classes.content: Selected dimensions and numeric measures, point labels, x/y/size mappings and grouping choices, calculated point tables and context, charts, diagnostics and interpretation. Local numerical/rendering code makes no separate model call. Reading original data or outputs adds those actual values to host context; no automatic anonymization is applied. Any separately requested publication uses the parent reporting route.
